evidence.name: Screen field: Recover users who cancel checkout
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Recover users who cancel checkout" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Recover users who cancel checkout
sections.description: Lets you send people who start checkout but back out to a cheaper plan or discount offer instead of just closing the dialog. Catching abandoners this way can recover lost revenue, but you must build that follow-up screen first and connect it here. Leave it empty until you have one — then the dialog simply closes and the user stays on the paywall.
